title: Kuwaiti tanker hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz
excerpt: A Kuwaiti tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire, as Russia claimed drone strikes on cargo vessels in the Black Sea.
x_post: Kuwaiti tanker KAZIMAH III was hit by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire; crew reported safe. Russia claimed drone strikes on a cargo vessel in the Black Sea. #MaritimeSecurity #StraitOfHormuz #BlackSea #Seafarers
